objective: Implement all accepted frontend feature-parity and new-protocol recommendations locally before push/publication. Production protocol yield history must be globally shared, with complete explicit multi-chain coverage.
constraints: Local stage and testing first; no git push, production publication, deployment, mainnet transaction or actual payment without the existing review/owner process.
Preserve existing production repositories and the six reviewed protocol clients.
Retain Rift payment/order safeguards and existing production order keys.
No keys or RPC credentials in browser assets, logs or history.
No numerical rates or zero income inferred from unavailable history/prices.
New-contract execution gated until deployed addresses and runtime/links are verified.
